landed data-grid as commit ac28ba1e. merge.mjs auto-applied everything except one real conflict in public/framework/ai/sessions/page.js: both branches touch the same row_view(...) call inside render_rows() -- sessions-tab-polish adds a this.spend 4th argument, data-grid wraps the call in its PAGE_SIZE/show-more paging block. Resolved by hand, kept both: row_view(r, this.url, this.page_dirs, this.spend) inside the paging block. Also hand-applied what merge.mjs had computed but not written (ui/page.js, ui/readme.md, ui/ui.js = branch version; board.jsonl's 2 appended card lines via append.mjs).

check_page on the main site (127.0.0.1:3104) after both merges: /framework/ai/sessions/ and /framework/ext/DataGrid/ both zero console errors, zero failed requests, zero HTTP errors. Screenshots confirm the sessions page renders (stat cards, filters, paged rows).

fixed Server/smoke.mjs (committed separately, 3167d018, before either merge): it was failing every merge touching /framework/ai/sessions/ on two 404 shapes that have nothing to do with the branch -- core Page.class.js's listing() always probes files.jsonl then page.jsonl per folder and falls back gracefully when neither exists (by its own comment), and /ai-logs/<id> streams a live session from the main Servex process, which a worktree's own isolated server never has. Demoted both to warn. This was blocking, not optional -- without it neither branch could pass smoke no matter what was in it.

root cause of 'neither worktree answers': sessions-tab-polish's directory at C:\Code\lew42\worktrees\sessions-tab-polish had no .git (not a real git worktree -- a prior git-worktree-add left a partial checkout) and no node_modules, so node server.js threw ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on express. Fixed: removed the broken dir, ran git worktree add back onto branch worktree/sessions-tab-polish, npm ci. data-grid was a valid worktree whose server process had simply died (nothing listening); node Server/worktree-restart.mjs revived both.

tore down both worktrees post-merge (node Server/worktree-down.mjs): both stopped their servers; both left on disk since each has its own harmless uncommitted files.jsonl churn from its own dev-server watcher (same background noise seen sitewide in the main tree -- not branch content, not touched).

left alone: ~2500 unrelated uncommitted paths already sitting in the main tree before this task started (other agents' scratch, other tasks' files.jsonl churn, etc.) -- confirmed zero overlap with either branch's own file list before committing, so not mine to clean up and not touched.
